seed: The Export sheet's Size row, at Next defaults with no flag touched: a five minute talk recorded at Retina size, 2880 by 1800, opens; Export shows Full, 1080p and 720p with the full size named in pixels; 1080p changes the pixel line and the size line; and the five minutes written at 1080p land as a 1728 by 1080 file whose weight is within a factor of two of what the sheet said.

steps.note: A Retina screen recording is 2880 by 1800, and the sheet could only write it at that size: five minutes came to hundreds of megabytes. People post 1080p and 720p, which is what Premiere offers. This walk opens a five minute recording at Retina size and exports it at 1080p
Export on MP4: a Size row under Format, reading Full with the recording's own pixels, then 1080p and 720p
1080p picked: the pixel line says 1728 × 1080 and the size line drops with it
